# Repository instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical task and review workflow. Do not duplicate its full instructions here.

Before changing project files, read `BRIEFING.md`, `CONTEXT.es.md`, `company-choice.md`, the relevant local README, and the relevant files in `memory-bank/`. Apply the active guidance in `.agents/rules/` and any matching skill in `.agents/skills/`.

Use **Ask → Plan → Agent → Review**. Distinguish documented facts, hypotheses and approved decisions in plans and summaries. Keep changes within the existing course milestone and monorepo routes. Do not modify the official `BRIEFING.md`, add real patient data or secrets, or infer an approved technology stack from template examples.
